text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We wrap up today's training and are<n>about to part
ways when...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... All right. That felt prettygood!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My Pegasus Mach Strike still has<n>plenty of room to
evolve!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I should run another lap while this<n>feeling is fresh!
That way, I'm sure to<n>become even stronger than
before!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrrrr! Biko's up to her stupid special<n>training
again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No way I'm losin' to some chump<n>hero! I gotta do
my own special<n>training!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Just watch me! I'm gonna leave that<n>hero
speechless!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wait until she gets a load of my<n>ultimate
attack—Windy Dynamite!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Once I'm done training,<n>my ultimate
attack'll be even more<n>wicked!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ya hear that, Biko?! There's no way<n>I'm ever
gonna lose to you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy continues her special<n>training until
she feels completely<n>satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Looking down on her from<n>some place up
high sounds exactly<n>like what a supervillain would
do!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And I could munch on some snacks<n>while I'm at it!
What a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
WAHAHAHA! I already have more<n>than enough
power! So try your best<n>to catch up, Justice Biko. I
won't be<n>expectin' much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy cheerfully watches on<n>as Biko
Pegasus does her special<n>training.
